dogecoin.text:
@blaktron @krakenfx I was a dogecoin millionaire back in 2014, too. It's all a question of reference currency.

That is: 1 Doge = 1 Doge. 😋

I eventually got sufficiently annoyed at not getting the Dogecoin off of my original Pebble Watch after an hour of tinkering today that I checked on the one other place I knew a backup paper wallet of this had to exist: my physical 2015 third party continuity package folder.
I really don't make 420 jokes (except the one I've been waiting to make for more than a decade, when the Amsterdam Stock Exchange turns 420 next year), but... It's Dogecoin. 🤷‍♂️❤️

I think I've found the thing to spend the Dogecoin I reclaimed from my Pebble Watch on.

I just need to find a place to put it. 🤔

@occupymars42069 @DogecoinFdn We don't want to boost it, though. That's also why we wrote from the @DogecoinFdn account rather than @dogecoin to begin with. We're working on more proper response.
@blaktron @DogecoinFdn @BillyM2k @dogecoin_devs @UltraProIntl @kabosumama (redid tweets 3 & 4 to clarify a bit more)

@blaktron @DogecoinFdn @BillyM2k @dogecoin_devs @UltraProIntl @kabosumama So, to answer your question: we are actively  looking into this, but right now, we are primarily working to quash the bad faith trademark applications/registrations for "Dogecoin" and the Dogecoin logos. 4/4

@blaktron @DogecoinFdn @BillyM2k @dogecoin_devs @UltraProIntl @kabosumama We reached out to them back then and reached an agreement with them to protect the Dogecoin community.

Of course, UltraPro did not apply for trademark protection in the financial services category and an argument could be made that Dogecoin has broad recognition in that area. 3/

@blaktron @DogecoinFdn @BillyM2k @dogecoin_devs "Doge" as a meme obviously preceded it. Trademarks and memes are a fascinating subject, but without going into too much detail: @UltraProIntl actually made an agreement with @kabosumama in 2014 and trademarked "Doge." 2/

@Fantoumi Don't want to jinx it or say something that then doesn't materialise, but generally about ideas to increase Dogecoin adoption in certain industries. Will be able to say more in next few days.

It's hard for me to overstate what a pleasure it has been to work with Tim and how glad I am that he was one of the first people we approached and the first to say yes after Michi, Ross, and Max had approached me about reviving the Dogecoin Foundation after its long hiatus. ♥️

Just went through CBP/TSA/Security at MIA and the CBP person recognised my Dogecoin shirt and asked about it. Happens occasionally, but always fun. And was the friendliest pass through CBP I've ever had. 😅

Part of me is like: oh come on.
But another part of me thinks: fuck it, my yacht in GTA Online was called DOGECOIN for the longest time, I should just get with the program and hope to establish a Lineage of Rogue Traders that survives the next 39,000 years. 🧐

@rivatez It's funny. I keep talking to people from the time and a lot of them that withdrew from crypto for a while (myself included) are kinda coming back. It's also why I'm still so fond of Dogecoin and it's potential to embody that.

We actually should have another chat sometime. ❤️
